name: CreateAgency
precondition: No existing membership is assumed. The identity must be verified and creation abuse limits must admit the request.
effect: Create one draft agency and owner membership atomically; do not activate contracts or billing automatically.
failure: A repeated identical key returns the same agency; a conflicting key rejects without a second tenant.

name: ActivateAgency
precondition: The caller is the current owner; legal/billing profile and required agreements are complete for the actual purchasing entity.
effect: Record versioned acceptance and activate only eligible capabilities.
failure: Missing agreements or a mismatched billing identity leave the agency draft; no implicit signature.

name: InviteMember
precondition: The requested role is within the inviter's grantable subset; member limits and intended identity are checked.
effect: Create one expiring invitation with a hashed single-use token and explicit agency scope.
failure: A forwarded or expired token cannot grant membership to a different person.

name: AcceptInvitation
precondition: The authenticated identity matches the invitation and the invitation has not been consumed, revoked or expired.
effect: Atomically consume the invitation and activate the intended scoped membership.
failure: Concurrent acceptances produce one membership; raw tokens never enter logs.

name: ChangeMembership
precondition: Step-up is current; the operation cannot remove the final active owner or grant an unauthorized capability.
effect: Change role with an audit event and invalidate affected sessions/authorization caches.
failure: A stale version or client-invented privileged role makes no change.

name: RevokeMembership
precondition: The revoker has authority over this membership; last-owner protection is checked in the same transaction.
effect: Revoke future access, invalidate membership caches and prevent new signed-download grants.
failure: Existing short-lived bearer links follow their disclosed expiry; do not claim instant revocation where provider capabilities cannot deliver it.

name: TransferOwnership
precondition: Both persons and the destination membership are verified; required recipient acceptance is recorded.
effect: Perform a versioned ownership transfer without leaving the agency ownerless.
failure: Cross-agency or suspended recipients reject; billing/legal entity is not changed implicitly.

name: UpdateBranding
precondition: The logo passed the safe media pipeline; branding rights and tenant scope are confirmed.
effect: Create a new branding version for future reports while preserving already delivered artifact identity.
failure: Unsafe SVG/script, invalid media or a foreign artifact reject; no remote image fetch from arbitrary URLs.

name: CreateClient
precondition: Active agency membership permits client creation and records the end-client processing authority.
effect: Create one scoped workspace with stable identity separate from its display name.
failure: Duplicate labels are not merged by inference; a foreign authority reference rejects.

name: ArchiveClient
precondition: The workspace belongs to the caller's agency and active paid work has been reviewed.
effect: Stop new project creation while retaining active work and lawful history according to their own policies.
failure: Archiving cannot become an implicit deletion or refund.

name: CreateProject
precondition: The client is active; the requested mode is offered and target scope is declared without claiming qualification.
effect: Create a project with a draft revision and visible readiness blockers.
failure: An unavailable mode returns CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE before quoting or charging.

name: CreateRevision
precondition: The project permits revision creation; predecessor belongs to it and replacement allowance is evaluated separately.
effect: Create new mutable input identity and explicit lineage; preserve sealed predecessor bytes.
failure: Do not carry old validation, approval or paid execution authority onto changed bytes.

name: ReserveUpload
precondition: Revision is mutable; per-file, revision, concurrency and storage reservations fit actual limits.
effect: Reserve bytes and create a narrowly scoped resumable session with an application acceptance deadline.
failure: A provider session is returned only to its authorized requester; quota races cannot oversubscribe the revision.

name: CompleteUpload
precondition: The upload belongs to the caller and is not cancelled, expired or already sealed.
effect: Observe provider generation/length/hash, scan coverage and structure before admission; completion remains asynchronous.
failure: Declared size/hash or browser completion alone cannot mark the file ready.

name: CancelUpload
precondition: The operation belongs to the caller; cancellation remains valid while verification races.
effect: Tombstone application acceptance, cancel provider session where supported and clean late objects.
failure: Late finalization cannot resurrect the cancelled file or consume freed quota twice.

name: SelectInputTables
precondition: Detected worksheets, hidden tables, formulas, parser issues and object projections are visible for review.
effect: Persist explicit selected/excluded tables and parser choices in the mutable revision.
failure: Missing or newly changed tables invalidate previous selection; no hidden-sheet silent inclusion.

name: SealRevision
precondition: All selected files are admitted and immutable, counts/projections are confirmed and no upload remains unresolved.
effect: Atomically seal manifest, bytes, parser settings and billable-unit interpretation.
failure: A changed generation, incomplete scan or version conflict leaves no executable sealed revision.

name: CreateTargetContract
precondition: The structured metadata artifact is admitted and belongs to the target instance; it is data, not executable schema.
effect: Validate metadata, scope and observed facts and create an immutable draft target version.
failure: Reject mismatched CRM/object/instance and unknown fields; caller cannot set verified=true.

name: ConfirmTargetContract
precondition: The complete body and actual destination scope are disclosed; observation is fresh and the actor has confirmation authority.
effect: Record confirmation of that exact contract without altering its body.
failure: A reused digest over changed metadata or future observation rejects.

name: StartAudit
precondition: Source is sealed/available, target is eligible, agency audit concurrency fits and a conservative funded grant can be reserved.
effect: Create a durable audit, deadlines and budget reservation; enqueue one logical operation.
failure: No budget or stale target returns a typed blocker without a provider call.

name: CancelAudit
precondition: The caller owns the audit and cancellation has not been superseded by a terminal accepted result.
effect: Atomically advance cancellation authority and stop new dispatch/promotion; reconcile possible provider liability.
failure: A late validator response cannot publish SYSTEM_DRAFT after the cancellation wins.

name: CreatePlan
precondition: The audit result and decision evidence are complete and compatible with source, target and policy.
effect: Compile the selected candidate set through the allowed primitive intersection into a new draft plan.
failure: Missing, duplicated or invented candidates reject; natural-language rationale is not executable authority.

name: RevisePlan
precondition: The typed patch names existing candidates/fields and permitted effects; the caller can edit this scope.
effect: Create a new plan revision and invalidate dependent validation/approval.
failure: A stale UI cannot edit or approve the previous version as if current.

name: ValidatePlan
precondition: Exact source, target, core and policy bindings are available and the required resource grant is admitted.
effect: Run full-data deterministic validation and persist a complete receipt with evidence hashes.
failure: Null, incomplete, wrong-subject, future or cancelled receipts never become VALID.

name: ApprovePlan
precondition: Current nonblocking validation and complete material effects are disclosed to the authorized actor.
effect: Create immutable approval for exact plan/source/target/disclosures.
failure: Any changed effect, expired source or stale receipt requires new review; generic cleanup approval cannot authorize undisclosed CLEAR.

name: WithdrawApproval
precondition: The actor controls this approval; already completed external/customer actions are identified separately.
effect: Revoke future execution authority and route active work through the cancellation/reconciliation policy.
failure: Do not delete history or promise rollback of an agency-performed CRM import.

name: CreateQuote
precondition: The scope, exact count, capability, customer identity and fiscal treatment are resolved for a saleable order.
effect: Compute server price, maximum eligible discount, taxes, expiry and immutable terms.
failure: Zero-unit or unqualified work cannot be charged as a minimum-price project; incomplete tax facts block issuance.

name: CreatePaymentOrder
precondition: Price and source are independently valid, approval remains exact, live merchant/fiscal route is qualified and charge terms are accepted.
effect: Persist payment intent before creating one provider order.
failure: Source expiry racing order creation prevents new capture authority; an ambiguous provider creation is reconciled.

name: CapturePayment
precondition: The stored order matches amount, currency, payee, environment and still-valid commercial prerequisites.
effect: Capture through the server adapter and authenticate/reconcile the provider result.
failure: Browser success, forged event or unknown result cannot create CommercialAuthorization.

name: ReceivePaymentWebhook
precondition: Ingress authenticates provider-specific signature, freshness, environment and bounded raw body before event acceptance.
effect: Store a deduplicated durable inbox entry and reconcile it with the local order.
failure: Wrong payee/currency/order or invalid signature rejects; duplicates do not add money or commissions.

name: RequestRefund
precondition: The request is within the customer's scope; possible service/tax allocation is visible but not self-approved.
effect: Create a reviewable refund request with delivery, terms and evidence references.
failure: Customer cancellation is not direct permission to send arbitrary PSP refunds.

name: ApproveRefund
precondition: Available refundable balance, exact terms, legal obligations and commission/fiscal effects are prepared.
effect: Record the authorized amount and reason as an immutable refund intent.
failure: The total cannot exceed reconciled remaining capture; a standing authorized policy must be referenced rather than invented.

name: ExecuteRefund
precondition: A valid unreversed refund authorization exists and any prior ambiguous submission is reconciled.
effect: Submit once per reconciled provider identity and publish final refund/credit-note/commission events.
failure: Timeout stays UNCERTAIN with no blind duplicate financial effect.

name: ReconcilePayment
precondition: Authenticated current provider observation is available and the service identity has scoped permission.
effect: Advance local facts from actual provider state and record mismatch incidents.
failure: A provider pending/held state is never coerced to settled available cash.

name: IssueTaxDocument
precondition: Actual operator, numbering, reviewed treatment and provider entitlement are valid; no unreconciled prior submission exists.
effect: Issue the exact document and reconcile legal number and fiscal acceptance.
failure: A list's first page is not proof of absence; exact identity/pagination prevents duplicate invoices.

name: ExecuteProject
precondition: Current source, plan, target, approval, capture, retention, capability and funded capacity all bind consistently.
effect: Atomically create one logical job and outbox command.
failure: Duplicate requests reuse the job; revoked authority or full queue cannot silently start a second execution.

name: CancelJob
precondition: The caller owns the project; active provider state and published artifacts are identified.
effect: Advance cancellation fence, stop new promotion and reconcile actual provider termination.
failure: A still-live old worker cannot publish a valid package; cancellation is not customer CRM rollback.

name: AuthorizeDownload
precondition: Current membership, package status, artifact scope and retention are valid for each requested item.
effect: Issue scoped short-lived capabilities and an audit event without exposing unrelated objects.
failure: Expired/deleted/quarantined artifacts deny; a shared cache must not reuse another user's signed URL.

name: VerifyPackage
precondition: The exact immutable package is available and the verifier version/inputs are known.
effect: Recompute artifact bytes, scope, counts, lineage and semantic checks and record the result.
failure: Matching manifest sums with wrong data or forbidden fields still fails.

name: SubmitStageReceipt
precondition: Receipt belongs to the current stage and actual target instance; uploaded content passed admission.
effect: Validate exact membership and source-to-target IDs, including failed and missing records.
failure: Foreign IDs, duplicate mappings or partial unresolved parents block affected child edges.

name: ContinueStage
precondition: Required parent receipts, approved child plan and bounded staged retention remain valid.
effect: Prepare the next stage from verified identities without reimporting parents.
failure: Expired workflow or mismatched target requires explicit recovery, not guessed IDs.

name: RequestDeletion
precondition: The exact project scope and consequences are disclosed; applicable legal residuals are identified.
effect: Tombstone authority before deleting raw/derived artifacts and update the external restore journal.
failure: Crash or restored database cannot resurrect data; lawful residuals are shown rather than falsely certified erased.

name: CloseAgency
precondition: Active jobs, funds, refunds, legal records and team access consequences have been prepared.
effect: Stop new work, settle/reconcile existing obligations and schedule managed-scope deletion/closure.
failure: Closure cannot erase payable seller rights, fiscal obligations or customer refund rights.

name: CreateSupportCase
precondition: The person has access to the project and submitted evidence is safely scoped/minimized.
effect: Create a classified case with accountable next response and visible status.
failure: Raw secrets/CRM files do not enter email or generic telemetry; route secure upload when needed.

name: RegisterProspect
precondition: Lawful source, purpose, suppression and seller access are checked.
effect: Create a minimized prospect without granting customer data access or automatic attribution.
failure: A suppressed identity cannot be reactivated through spelling or duplicate-list import.

name: ClaimProspect
precondition: Seller terms are active and evidence shows substantive acquisition work within allowed scope.
effect: Create a reviewable attribution claim; submission alone does not own the agency.
failure: Existing accepted claims or customer history route to conflict review.

name: AcceptAttribution
precondition: Conflicts, actual agency identity, claim timing and pool shares have been reviewed under signed terms.
effect: Freeze accepted acquisition attribution and claim window; record any agreed split totaling 100%.
failure: Assignment edits or two full-rate sellers cannot duplicate the commission pool.

name: AssignAccount
precondition: The seller is active and the service role/compensation are prepared.
effect: Change operational responsibility while preserving historical attribution and earned rights.
failure: No silent reset of the twelve-month window or first-project designation.

name: ActivateSeller
precondition: Identity, legal classification, signed terms, English/product assessment, access and payment facts are complete.
effect: Activate least-privilege seller capabilities and the agreed compensation version.
failure: A contractor label without reviewed substance or unsigned terms cannot activate.

name: TerminateSeller
precondition: Actual legal obligations, earned/residual commissions and enumerated opportunity tail are prepared.
effect: End new assignment/access, preserve signed residuals and define the eligible ninety-day opportunity tail.
failure: Do not erase the ledger, forfeit rights by a role change or grant a tail over an entire scraped list.

name: CloseCommissionPeriod
precondition: Captures, cumulative refunds, delivery milestones, available funds and disputes are reconciled at cutoff.
effect: Issue an immutable statement with itemized basis, rates, adjustments, holds and payout date.
failure: Unknown settlement or missing final completion remains a reasoned hold, not invented eligibility.

name: ApproveCommissionPayout
precondition: Statement, legal documentation, exact payee/currency/fees and actual available funds are prepared.
effect: Create a reviewable authorized payout intent for eligible value.
failure: No arbitrary minimum, silent fee deduction or unauthorized funds transfer.

name: ReconcileCommissionPayout
precondition: Authenticated payout/bank evidence matches the intended seller and amount.
effect: Mark actual paid value and preserve any failed/returned transfer for recovery.
failure: Submitting a transfer is not proof the seller received it.

name: OpenBreakglass
precondition: A concrete incident/support need and necessary customer-data scope have been established.
effect: Issue a short-lived audited least-privilege grant with automatic expiry and review.
failure: Blanket raw-data access, unrelated tenant access or silent reuse rejects.

name: RevokeBreakglass
precondition: The active grant is identified and revocation is authorized.
effect: Revoke refresh authority and verify expiry of already issued capabilities.
failure: Do not claim zero residual bearer lifetime where the provider cannot revoke issued credentials instantly.

name: RecordIncident
precondition: Evidence identifies an actual event and safe affected scope.
effect: Create containment/recovery/communication responsibilities and a next checkpoint.
failure: A monitoring false positive is recorded as such; it cannot be fabricated as a resolved production outage.

name: AuthorizeRecovery
precondition: The concrete restore plan, costs, side effects, deletion tombstones and financial reconciliation are prepared.
effect: Run the authorized isolated restore and release only after integrity/tenant/deletion/financial checks.
failure: Restored old captures, jobs or deleted rows cannot trigger duplicate effects or resurrect authority.

name: ChangeCapability
precondition: Independent acceptance covers the exact object/operation/importer/resource envelope and existing commitments are reviewed.
effect: Create a prospective version and update sale/admission/compiler consumers together.
failure: A marketing edit cannot promote IMPLEMENTED_UNACCEPTED to AVAILABLE_LIMITED or AVAILABLE.

name: RestrictCapability
precondition: Concrete evidence shows unsafe or unavailable behavior; customer obligations are identified.
effect: Block new admission, preserve evidence and route current work to the appropriate recovery/refund process.
failure: Do not silently change the scope of an already paid project.

name: RequestRetentionExtension
precondition: Current data/workflow is unexpired, the agency has authority, no prior project extension exists, and the requested soft extension is at most 259200 seconds within the original hard cap.
effect: Record one explicit contractual soft-deadline extension, its exact capped endpoint and restore-journal event; update all affected UI/scheduler consumers.
failure: Reject expired/deleted scope, a second extension, hard-cap change or stale version. A quote/retry cannot create this authority.

name: PrepareOutreachDraft
precondition: Current assignment, verified sender and allowed contact provenance are present; content passes safe claim and header checks.
effect: Create a versioned DRAFT and content binding; no external message is sent.
failure: Wrong assignment or unsupported claims reject without revealing the contact or creating send authority.

name: AuthorizeOutreach
precondition: Explicit owner permission binds reviewed recipients/content and an allowed purpose, sender, validity and bounded count.
effect: Commit one revocable bounded grant; record the actual permission without inventing standing consent.
failure: Expired, empty, excessive or ungrounded grants reject and cannot activate a send queue.

name: SendAuthorizedOutreach
precondition: Current sender/assignment, content, suppression, provider policy, validity and remaining grant quota all admit dispatch.
effect: Commit one fenced send intent; persist provider acceptance or explicit uncertainty and never infer delivery.
failure: Cancellation, opt-out or changed content blocks dispatch; uncertain provider acceptance requires reconciliation before any repeat.

name: RecordSalesActivity
precondition: Evidence supports the exact activity class and current scoped prospect access; a draft or API acknowledgment cannot become a customer reply.
effect: Append deduplicated evidence-backed commercial activity and stop follow-up after refusal, reply, bounce or suppression.
failure: Unsupported delivered/replied claims reject; duplicate external identity cannot count twice.
